node.statement: For n<=m, the standard zero-corner inclusion M_n tensor S_P into M_m tensor S_P is isometric by the operator-space axioms in def-hcb-datum, and h_m intertwines it with the corresponding isometric target inclusion because h_m is the entrywise amplification. The infimum over the larger domain is therefore no greater: a_m<=a_n, equivalently a_n>=a_m.
